Episode 2: transcript

Host: Welcome back. In this episode a single voice hums one low note for six seconds.

Interview with Ada Lovelace

Ada Lovelace: The Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves. Interviewer: What did you add to the notes on the engine? Ada Lovelace: I described how it could compute Bernoulli numbers, step by step, and I wrote that it might act upon other things besides number, such as musical sounds, if their relations could be expressed in the abstract science of operations. Interviewer: Thank you for your time.
